  • 英語名: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia 3

あらすじ

Peace has returned once again after resurrected Jinevra was defeated. Riesz goes to visit to her hometown in the other world to check it out after returning from her trip. Meanwhile, Marina and Souma enjoy their lives as lovers as peaceful days return.

However, the monsters appear once again. Then, Katsuragi Marina transforms into ExS-TIA once more and defeats the monsters. Marina and Souma continue fighting to protect everyone. Suddenly, another of the Four General, Naiolo, appears before them. Despite countless battles and accumulated growth, ExS-TIA is at mercy of Naiolo’s overwhelming power. With the power from her bond with Souma, Marina somehow manages to hold out. How will ExS-TIA fight against the new formidable enemy? The curtain of another battle has risen yet again.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: モンスターズ・レイド ～魔に堕ちる姫騎士～
  • 英語名: Monsters Raid Ma ni Ochiru Himekishi

あらすじ

In the distant past, a demon king led monsters in terrorizing the land. Despite efforts by powerful individuals from human, elf, and dragon tribes, they couldn’t defeat the demon king but managed to seal its power, bringing temporary peace. The three races then settled in different territories—humans in the plains, elves in the forests, and dragons in the mountains. Many years later, as monsters reappeared and attacks escalated, princess knight Celica, a descendant of the hero who sealed the demon king, led a small army to defend the village of Gazette in the Amusha Plains from a horde of monsters.

When she is at a loss what to do, Aramaki, her assistant, gives her an advice. According to Aramaki, she will be able to improve her magical power by feeling sexual pleasure. あらすじ

Monsters start to appear at a peaceful town. Magicians investigate the case and find out that the source of invasion is a dimensional distortion. Princesses with royal power are sent to deal with the situation. They are gifted with powers to control distortions, but need protection on the road, so main character is chosen to accompany them. Elfarina is the princess with the least magical power, so she seeks ways to be useful. She finds a book about sexual magic that raises power, but now she requires a male to undergo a full-scale study course.
